note: Historical identity of the retired @git-malu/stage-contracts 0.7.0 package. The tag stage-contracts-v0.7.0 is an annotated tag: producer_ref is its tag object and producer_commit is the commit it peels to. The two producer paths are the package blobs at that tag; the committed files are those bytes with the declared rewrites applied, which remove the retired package name and, since issue #266, rename the two repository-owner constants to the durable `anywear-ai` organization. Reversing the rewrites reproduces the recorded producer digests, so the producer's own `git-malu` owner names stay recorded only as the reverse side of those rewrites. This fixture is a dated historical record, not a current dependency.
